Name: Six Steven Universe Shirts
Author: stefuny75
Description:
This is my first mod. I made 6 Steven Universe shirts.<br />This mod includes shirts inspired by Pearl, Steven, Amethyst, Garnet, Lapis, and Peridot.<br />Enjoy!
Extract folder and paste into C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\Steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Character
Replace file that is already existing. Back up original if necessary.
